column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each infrastructure configuration record in the database. EX. 1,2,3
Piped water supply access type indicating the household's water infrastructure connectivity. Part of unique constraint combination. ex.Yes, available at least in one room
Street pavement condition and type describing the road infrastructure quality around the household location. Part of unique constraint combination. EX. Asphalt, concrete;Gravel surface
Private parking space availability indicating whether households have dedicated parking facilities. Part of unique constraint combination. EX.Available, not available
